text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...No. Don't stop. Don't ease up.
Faster! More! Faster, go faster!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Otherwise, to those girls...!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Uaaahhhhaaahhhhaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle in the lead!
K.S. Miracle in the lead!
What tremendous speed!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!!
Displaying overwhelming speed,
KS Miracle claims a magnificent victory!!”

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap~!! Isn't she even faster now
than during the Hakodate Sprint Stakes?!
Just how far is that girl gonna go~?!

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Just like you said before, they showed off a whole different level of speed!
Right?! ...Huh? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah.
That was incredible, seriously...

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
Like she could go on forever...
So fast, just too fast...

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text: It's almost a little scary—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*... phew...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I managed to win here... But—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Not yet, this isn't enough.
Not yet. Not at this kind of speed...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Still not enough.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Next... I want to run in the Centaur Stakes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The doctor said so too,
and physically, I'm completely fine.
...Please.

The moment she returned to the waiting room, she told me that
in an uncompromising tone, so I hurriedly stepped in to stop her.

"There is less than a month left until the Centaur Stakes.
On top of that, our main goal, the Sprinters Stakes, takes place in the same month of September."
choice_data_list: That gap is way too tight...!
That gap is way too tight...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
Still, I have to do it.

K.S.Miracle said so resolutely.
...It was the first time she had ever pushed back on this sort of topic.
It was the clear display of emotion from a girl who had always responded earnestly to my input until now—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I have to do it.
Please, Trainer.
It was her first act of resolute defiance.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I lack experience.
Not from training—it's the speed honed
only in real races that I'm missing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Our biggest rival in the Sprinters Stakes
is definitely Ruby. She debuted a year before me
and has been competing at the very top level all this time."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"There's already a huge gap in experience as it is.
...And on top of that, I'm treating the time from my debut
until the spring of the Classic year as preparation."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm still falling short.
To run ahead of Ruby and the others, the current me just isn't enough.

"There shouldn't be. From the Aoi Stakes up to this point,
I've steadily racked up graded race victories.
My preparation should be more than sufficient, and yet—"
Without a shred of hesitation, K.S.Miracle speaks.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I need to close that gap. I have to get faster.
Definitely before the Sprinters Stakes... Absolutely.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: So――please.

Even so, we cannot simply accept this defiance.
A schedule like that would put far too much strain on the body.

"She runs at speeds her already-fragile body can barely sustain.
Her risk of injury is far higher than anyone else's, and—"

"In races where girls run with their own bodies at speeds exceeding 60 km/h,
there is a very real possibility that an accident during a race could result in far more than just minor injuries."
To point out things that are so utterly obvious.
...I was about to say something, but caught my breath.

K.S.Miracle's gaze was tranquil.
Like a frozen lake, she simply looked at me,
quietly and deeply.

"...She knows it 'all too well.'
Of course, even she understands that much."
choice_data_list: Are you saying that knowing full well...?
Are you saying that knowing everything...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ......Please.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I will win at the Sprinters Stakes. On the greatest stage, I want to give back the greatest miracle to everyone."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That is my reason for living.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Because that's the only reason I'm alive.
A shudder ran through me. And then, a thought crossed my mind.
Is this truly her 'dream'?

"Winning at the Sprinters Stakes.
That is how I'll return the favor."

To achieve it no matter the stake—even if it means
throwing away one's body, heart, and life entirely.

"Can something like that…… can such a thing
really be called a 'dream'?"

My lips tremble. A chill runs down my spine.
Even so... with all my might, I ask.
choice_data_list: Is that what you really want to do?
Is that what you really want to do?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
What about you, Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Have you ever made your parents cry?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I do.
So many, so many...
...more than I could ever count.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
No way...
Your weight is still continuing to drop...?

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
I-I wonder why? I thought she had been
eating the food we brought her especially well lately,
though...

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: "...According to the nurse, she threw up almost everything after you left. Even though she was so happy that... she had managed to eat."

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Good girl, sleeping with the blanket pulled up properly,
Kei-chan. ...Your cheeks have gotten so much thinner, haven't they?"

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
If only I had made it... easier for you to eat...!

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not just your fault. I made plenty of them too.
If we're going to reflect on this... we do it together."

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Kay... Dad and the others will work harder. Even harder... harder...!

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...No, that's not it.)

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: (It's not Dad and the others who are bad.)

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: (The bad one is,)

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Kei-chan?
...Were you watching TV?

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's an Umamusume race.
Did the girl in the middle win?
That's wonderful, everyone is celebrating with her...

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—Right now, honestly,
I'm just filled with gratitude!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Standing here right now is nothing short of a miracle. And without everyone's support, I never could have done it—

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
To my family, to Trainer,
and to everyone who helped and cheered for me!
I want to tell them all thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume's Family
text_block_list.text:
Well, hearing you say that...
makes me blush a bit, but it does make me happy.
Of course, it's all thanks to her own hard work, though.

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume's Family
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in the massive cheers, running, winning...
That girl is our pride.
Our irreplaceable treasure.

text_block_list.name: Winning Umamusume's Family
text_block_list.text:
"...We truly are fortunate,
having met such a wonderful girl."

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...I'm happy.)

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Pride, treasure, ...happiness.)

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I, want to run.

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: Like that... I want to run... like that.

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to be able... to run. Me too—

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: (If I do that, maybe I can make everyone happy too.)

text_block_list.name: Young Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Will I stop being a bad kid, I wonder?)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Half of my life is made up of "thank yous"—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The other half is made of 'I'm sorry.'

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Running, winning—
all of it is what I want to do.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even so, there are things that must be done.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please.
Let me enter the Centaur Stakes.
I want to win the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please, just let me...
keep running like this.

I knew there were countless things I had to say.
As a mentor, as a guardian, and as an adult.

However, no words came out. No voice.
Not even a breath. ...I had no right.
She was in such a fragile, sorrowful state, yet what pushed her to start running again was...

"What decisively made them believe
that was their very reason for living."

If only I had understood everything from the beginning.
If only I had seen through to the true nature of her precariousness.
Belated regrets simply cycle endlessly through my mind.

No words came out, as usual.
Even so, when I simply nodded in silence—

Just as expected, K.S.Miracle was smiling—
looking happy,
and relieved.
